emailSummary.description: 1-2 sentence objective summary of why this evidence was received and what real-world event it represents in the student's world.

hasJourneyImpact.description: True if this email alters or impacts the student's academic or placement world state; false if spam, promotional, or irrelevant.

uncertainty.description: True ONLY if critical information like deadline dates or company identity is genuinely ambiguous.

uncertaintyReason.description: String explaining uncertainty, or null if confident.

commands.description: List of Business Commands emitted based on the evidence. Return empty array [] if hasJourneyImpact is false.

companyName.description: Company name if applicable, or null.

title.description: Clear, concise title for the opportunity, assessment, action item, or event.

role.description: Job/Internship role title if applicable, or null.

stage.description: Target timeline stage if advancing opportunity, or null.

ctc.description: Compensation/Stipend details if mentioned, or null.

scheduledTime.description: ISO-8601 date-time string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss) for interviews, assessments, or events, or null.

dueDate.description: ISO-8601 date-time string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss) for action item due dates or application deadlines, or null.

meetingLinkOrUrl.description: Meeting URL, assessment platform link, or application portal URL, or null.

description.description: Actionable instructions, required documents, or next steps.

evidenceQuote.description: Exact verbatim quote from the evidence content proving why this business command occurred in the student's world.
